summary: Built `desk:apps:book` as the guest book app, verified typing, Backspace, and saving, and removed the test entry.

files.desk:apps:book:
app 'Guest Book'
task start()
set names to []
when exists('desk:guestbook')
set names to lines(read('desk:guestbook'))
done
give {names: names, typed: ''}
done
task key(s, k)
when k is 'enter'
when count(s.typed) > 0
add('desk:guestbook', s.typed)
add s.typed to s.names
set s.typed to ''
done
otherwise
set s.typed to edit_text(s.typed, k)
done
give s
done
task draw(s)
title('Guest Book')
help('Type a name; Enter saves; Ctrl+Q closes')
show(1, 1, count(s.names) & ' guests')
set i to count(s.names)
set row to 3
while i > max(count(s.names) - 20, 0)
show(row, 1, item(s.names, i))
set i to i - 1
set row to row + 1
done
show(23, 1, 'name: ' & s.typed)
cursor(23, 7 + count(s.typed))
done
